issue6Lock: Bjorn's first meaningful modern contribution is leadership, not a contrived credential or physical-labor job. After a dangerous outburst rooted in discomfort with dependence, Carrie brings him to a mixed-era DTI temporal-refugee support group. A participant from the 1980s resents being treated as historical. Bjorn takes the group intensely seriously, challenges the competent group leader intellectually, and is challenged back. That relationship gives him respect. Other participants begin valuing his judgment and steadiness in small non-dependent ways, giving him meaning. Only later may this organically become employment; do not rush the group into a job pipeline.
